Subject: Initial scoping: log retention + customer key needs

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking the time earlier. I wanted to capture the top-level asks from Wellnest Security so your teams can advise on feasibility across Hosted vs Dedicated options. High level:

- We need per-tenant audit logs retained for 24 months, exportable in NDJSON.
- BYOK: customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) required for encryption-at-rest on any dedicated pool; key rotation cadence may be managed by our security team.
- SSO: SAML IdP assertions must include an "employee_id" attribute.

I've attached a short scoping sheet (wellnest_scoping.xlsx) with expected QPS and token volumes. Also looping in Auditify who will integrate the log exports for our SOC tooling. Can you advise: 1) any blockers to 24-month per-tenant export retention, and 2) whether Redwood requires escrow for BYOK keys to support failover?

Best,
Alice Turner
Head of Platform Security | Wellnest Health

Alice — thanks for the clear list and the scoping file. Quick summary from our side after a fast read:

- Audit logs: Hosted customers currently have a 12-month retention default; we can offer a longer retention via Dedicated with object-store export and an automated archival job. 24 months is doable but there are throughput and cost implications (we'll call out estimates).
- BYOK: Dedicated can accept customer-managed AWS KMS keys. Redwood does not, by default, hold key escrow for customer keys. However, we can offer an optional escrow/escrowed-wrapper service for DR if the customer requires it — that would be an add-on with a formal process and SLA.
- SSO attributes: SAML assertions with extra attributes are supported; we'll need Wellnest IdP metadata and sample assertions to validate attribute mapping.

I've flagged this for a deeper ops feasibility review. Can @Irene and @Priyom weigh in on technical constraints and an initial cost sketch? I'll follow up with a proposed call time.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin

Thanks for looping me in. A few technical notes from the infra/security engineering side:

- Per-tenant audit logs: we currently shard telemetry by tenant ID. Exporting NDJSON to a customer-controlled S3 bucket is supported for Dedicated. The main constraint is read/write pressure if the customer requests near-real-time streaming + long retention; we'd advise a batch export (hourly) and a lifecycle policy on the bucket.

- Storage and cost: storing 24 months of high-QPS logs will increase egress and storage. We estimate ~0.6–0.9TB/month at the sample QPS in the spreadsheet. We can provide a more precise cost model after a 24-hour sampling period.

- BYOK escrow: we avoid holding private key material. For DR failover, the standard pattern is a customer-managed key replicated across regions under the customer's KMS account and a documented key recovery process. If Wellnest requires Redwood to manage an escrow copy, we'd need legal signoff and HSM-backed storage (additional cost and SOC controls).

- SSO mapping: we'll need the IdP metadata URL and one successful test SAML assertion. If the assertion nameID does not contain employee_id, we can map a different attribute, but it needs to be stable.

Action items for Redwood ops:
1) Run a 24-hour trace against Wellnest test account to refine storage estimate (requested: Priyom).
2) Draft a BYOK escrow scoping note with legal (Marissa + Chloe).
3) Schedule SAML test with Wellnest (Chloe to propose times).

I can lead the 24-hour trace next week if we get credentials.

-Irene Choi
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quick update from infra/ops after doing the requested 24-hour sampling on a prod-like rig:

- Trace results: baseline matches the earlier estimate — ~0.8TB/month at current QPS. Peak day spikes may double that temporarily.
- Export mechanism: implemented via a nearline worker that batches log writes to S3. We can support the NDJSON shape provided by Auditify without changes.
- Practical constraint: retention beyond 18 months starts to make restore operations (replay for forensics) slower unless we index event timestamps externally; recommending we offer two tiers: 24-month cold retention (cheaper, slower restores) and an indexed 12-month tier (faster forensic restores).

Costing: preliminary monthly incremental storage + egress estimate: $X/month (see internal calc; will surface to Chloe/Marissa).
